name: My Ex-Future Family
source:
Main character has an amnesia. He forgot all, parents, sisters, friends, enemies. You will know all step by step.

Undress girls, help your friends and girlfriends, meet neigbours,seduce MILFS, start romantic stories with teens.

If you choose light side your love stories would be sweet, trying other side could open dark possibilities of your character.

[From F95Zone]

為女孩解開衣衫，向朋友和女友伸出援手，結識鄰居，追求風韻動人的熟女，或與青春正好的姑娘談一場戀愛。
